Participants cannot immediately know their rating changes.

Slide 3 – Core Prediction Engine
Mathematical Rating Model

Instead of directly training a machine learning model, the system first reconstructs LeetCode's rating behavior using mathematical modeling.

Components

✔ Elo-MMR Inspired Rating System

✔ Expected Rank Estimation

✔ Pairwise Probability Computation

✔ Geometric Mean Adjustment

Expected Rank

↓

√(Seed × Actual Rank)

✔ Zero-Sum Drift Correction

✔ Rating Calibration Layer

Machine Learning Enhancement

residual errors
nonlinear behaviour
outliers
rating deviations

More accurate predictions than using only mathematical formulas.
